sections.title: Assessments
sections.sql: select source_id,agent,reviewer,scorecard,version,kind,status,score,critical_failure,under_appeal,withdrawn from v_scores where conversation=(select source_id from conversations where id=$1)

sections.title: Reasons
sections.sql: select r.source_id review,k.name criterion,a.score,a.not_applicable,a.reason from ratings a join reviews r on r.id=a.review_id join criteria k on k.id=a.criterion_id where r.conversation_id=$1

sections.title: Appeal decisions
sections.sql: select a.source_id,a.reason,a.status,a.decision,a.decided_on from appeals a join reviews r on r.id=a.review_id where r.conversation_id=$1

sections.title: Commitment
sections.sql: select h.source_id,h.name,p.name owner,h.due_on,h.status,h.resolution,h.closed_on from coaching h join people p on p.id=h.owner_id where h.id=$1

sections.title: Assessment context
sections.sql: select s.agent,s.conversation,s.score,s.critical_failure,s.under_appeal,s.withdrawn from v_scores s join coaching h on h.review_id=s.id where h.id=$1
sections.note: Review an open appeal before using this action in a performance decision.
